'''Sälãi Käsi''' or '''Hidden Hand''' was a [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] religious order that [[Eaden Vrill]] was a member of, headed up by legendary [[Neaed Fisto]]. All members were minimally [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] which is why the order was targeted for destruction along with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] when [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was implemented. As of [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] only two members remained.
